evidence: Te Whara Track starts at Ocean Beach car park on Ranui Road.
The track ends at the Urquharts Bay car park.
The track is not a loop, so you will need to arrange transport.
You can start the track from either Ocean Beach car park on Ranui Road or Urquharts Bay car park at the end of Urquharts Bay Road.

doubts: There is no road-end feature for the Ocean Beach car park on Ranui Road, and the only nearby entry, the place Ocean Beach (T10), is a locality rather than the car park, so the start has no ref. Urquharts Bay car park is F1, the road end where the track meets Urquharts Bay Road. The Peach Cove Track entrance has no feature, so its access point ref is the walk link L2, and it is also given as an exit by track; its junction with the way is not stated, so from is null. The Smugglers Bay loop is a shorter alternative walk, not a way of this track. The Peach Cove Hut is only reached by the turnoff, so it is not on the route. The Urquharts Bay start is described as an alternative start for the same track, so it is an access point, not a second way.
